trading.title: Trading Rules
trading.desc: Atlas Funded provides a flexible trading environment while enforcing responsible risk management.
trading.notice: Rules may change. Always review the latest Atlas Funded rulebook.

rules.title: No prohibited arbitrage
rules.text: Latency/arbitrage exploitation strategies are not allowed.

rules.title: Respect risk limits
rules.text: Daily and overall drawdown limits must always be respected.

general.title: General Rules
general.notice: Rules may be updated. Please review regularly.

rules.title: Single user policy
rules.text: Each account must be traded only by the registered trader.

rules.title: Accurate KYC details
rules.text: Provide correct personal details for verification and payouts.

rules.title: Rule compliance required
rules.text: Any material violation can result in account termination.

1-step-pro.title: 1-Step Pro Challenge Rules
1-step-pro.desc: Rules for the 1-Step Pro account model.

rules.title: Trading Period
rules.text: Unlimited trading period for both Step 1 and Funded stages.

rules.title: Minimum Trading Days
rules.text: Minimum 4 trading days are required in Step 1 and Funded. Each qualifying trading day must generate at least 1% profit.

rules.title: Profit Target
rules.text: Step 1 profit target is 9%. There is no profit target in the Funded stage.

rules.title: Maximum Overall Loss
rules.text: Maximum overall loss is 6% in both Step 1 and Funded.

rules.title: Maximum Daily Loss
rules.text: Maximum daily loss is 3% in both Step 1 and Funded.

rules.title: Expert Advisors
rules.text: Expert Advisors are allowed in both Step 1 and Funded.

rules.title: Profit Split
rules.text: Funded traders receive a 100% profit split by default as specified in the 1-Step Pro rules.

rules.title: Evaluation Profit
rules.text: Evaluation profit is 15%, paid on the 3rd Reward.

rules.title: Refundable Fee
rules.text: The refundable fee is refunded on the 4th Reward.

rules.title: Default First Reward
rules.text: The first reward is available after 30 days.

rules.title: Subsequent Rewards
rules.text: After the first reward, subsequent rewards are available every 30 days.

rules.title: Bi-Weekly Reward Add-On
rules.text: The Bi-Weekly Reward add-on costs +10%. With this add-on, the first reward is after 30 days and each subsequent reward is every 14 days.

rules.title: Weekly Reward Add-On
rules.text: The Weekly Reward add-on costs +20%. With this add-on, the first reward is after 21 days and each subsequent reward is every 7 days.

rules.title: 100% Profit Split Add-On
rules.text: The 100% Profit Split add-on has a +20% cost increase.

rules.title: No Minimum Trading Days Add-On
rules.text: The No Minimum Trading Days add-on has a +20% cost increase.

rules.title: Free Retry Add-On
rules.text: The Free Retry add-on has a +25% cost increase.

rules.title: Available Add-Ons
rules.text: Available add-ons are Weekly Reward (+20%), Bi-Weekly Reward (+10%), 100% Profit Split (+20%), No Minimum Trading Days (+20%), and Free Retry (+25%).

importantNote.text: Read all rules before placing trades on your challenge or funded account.
